# Gruvbox Light

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light)

Gruvbox Light is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Gruvbox family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `gruvboxLight` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { gruvboxLight } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-gruvbox-light';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, gruvboxLight],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `gruvboxLight` | `Extension` |
| `gruvboxLightMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#fbf1c7` |
| Active line | `#fceab1` |
| Selection | `#e7d7ae` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#9d0006` | bold | 7.60:1 | 7.20:1 | 6.05:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#9d0006` | bold | 7.60:1 | 7.20:1 | 6.05:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#3c3836` | - | 10.22:1 | 9.69:1 | 8.13:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#6a5c4e` | - | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#076678` | - | 5.82:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.63:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#076678` | - | 5.82:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.63:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#845408` | - | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#306947` | - | 5.72:1 | 5.42:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#306947` | - | 5.72:1 | 5.42:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#845408` | italic | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#076678` | italic | 5.82:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.63:1 |
| String | `string` | `#65600d` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.43:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#65600d` | - | 5.73:1 | 5.43:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#8f3f71` | - | 5.94:1 | 5.63:1 | 4.72:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#a63b0f` | - | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#076678` | - | 5.82:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.63:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#6a5c4e` | italic | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#6a5c4e` | - | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |

| Heading | `heading` | `#845408` | bold | 5.69:1 | 5.39:1 | 4.53:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#3c3836` | background, active line, selection | 8.13:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#6b5e54` | gutter | 4.56:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#a63b0f` | background, active line | 5.39:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#a63b0f` | background | 5.69:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #a63b0f` | background, active line | 5.39:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#a63b0f, 1px solid #a63b0f` | background (fill or outline) | 5.69:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#e7d7ae` | active line | 1.19:1 | Pass |
